annotation.title_en: The Bet Jar and the Bull Terrier
annotation.summary_en: A man attempts to win a jar full of money by completing three tasks: drinking a bottle of tequila, pulling a bull terrier's tooth, and satisfying an elderly woman.
annotation.summary_detailed_en: The sketch begins at a bar where a man notices a jar filled with money. The bartender explains it is a betting jar: to win the cash, one must pay five dollars and complete three difficult challenges. The man agrees to the terms: first, he must drink an entire bottle of tequila in one go; second, he must enter the backyard and pull a diseased tooth from a fierce bull terrier using only his bare hands; and third, he must engage in and satisfy an elderly, pimply woman in a private room provided by the bar. The man successfully downs the tequila and staggers out to face the dog. The visuals then shift to a village setting where two men are perched on a corrugated rooftop near a chimney and a stork's nest, observing the scene below. After a period of loud commotion and barking, the man returns to the bar, disheveled and drunk. In a classic comedic reversal, he asks, 'Where is the old woman whose tooth I have to pull?', implying he mistakenly tried to satisfy the dog instead of the woman.
catchphrases: հը ուրա պառավը բերեք ատամը քաշեմ
